verdict.rationale: Reader explicitly supports a headless-Chrome engine (`x-engine: browser`) with tunable timing (`x-respond-timing`) and a wait-for-selector option to wait for specific DOM elements before returning content, plus a bundled Docker image containing headless Chrome for JS execution — together these directly enable full JS rendering of SPAs into clean output. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of successful SPA rendering (community comments only note uncertainty about JS support, not a concrete failure) and a documented benchmark/example against a real SPA.
